mentions.name: Personal AI Librarian
mentions.description: A personal AI librarian that makes large collections of local EPUB and PDF files accessible again. It helps users rediscover forgotten files, find information by meaning, explore unexpected connections, and save discoveries for future interests or projects.
mentions.problem: Large local collections of EPUB and PDF files become inaccessible and forgotten; users can't find information in their own documents or rediscover what they have.
mentions.audience: people with large collections of local epub and pdf files
